reviews.title: used to love, now hate
reviews.text: me and my friends love this app, we use it all the time. however, the most recent update has made it unusable. i no longer have the ability to take two photos at once, which was my favorite feature in the app. it now only takes one, and that’s if the camera even decides to work. the AI detection feature is annoying and unnecessary. also, my friends’ photos often don’t show up on only my phone when they post, all that i see is the map with their location. i thought i was the only one with these issues but it seems like it’s happening to everyone. please revert back to your old version so i can go back to loving your app again!

reviews.title: Was great, but change ruined it
reviews.text: Before yesterday you were able to simultaneously take front and back pictures from one button. Now you can only take one picture. Please change back.

reviews.title: Great App Update Sucks

reviews.title: Bring back the old beer buddy!
reviews.text: The new update is awful!! Please bring back the old beer buddy! The ai detection thing doesn’t work and won’t let you even take photos. If you want to add a new drink to the app, it won’t let you anymore because it doesn’t even detect there’s any drink in the photo you take let alone  what kind of beverage it is so you can add it to the app. It was perfect a few months ago but the new updates have ruined the app! I love beer buddy and want to keep using it with my friends so please fix it 🩷

reviews.title: Good until u get logged out
reviews.text: I had a great experience on this app for months. I recently got a new phone and when I went to use the app on it, it fully logged me out. Fine, until when I try to login in with credentials I know for a fact are correct, I get error codes and won’t let me in. I swiped out to maybe reset the app, and now it wants me to create a new account. It gives me no option to log in to an existing account and just wants me to create a user name. I’m irritated because I have so many memories and friends on it.
